summary: HD Create New Character screen replaces InterfaceNdNewChar
author: pm
body:
The user finished the HD Create New Character art (working/classic_ui/hd/character_creation_screen.png, 2053x1080: a 1920x1080 backdrop plus a strip of eight 48x33 arrow and +/- buttons) and approved the mockup on 2026-11-25 ("Yes, wire it in"). Every element keeps its place relative to its panel on the old screen (user: "The layout should match the existing character selection in relative placement"); value boxes are recesses cut into the panel like the select screen's (user: "It should match the other boxes on the character selection screen").

Mockup and spec: .claude/scratch/editor/create_char/ (mockup.png, spec.md). Accepted as mocked up: touching button rows, 20 px help text, the new special-points-left line.

**Done when:** the screen draws from the new art in the client at 4:3 and wide, every control works (name, appearance and stat buttons, presets, Create, Cancel, help text), the old intermediate_screens sheet 006 is archived and no longer loaded, builds clean, review passes.

Source: user, 2026-11-25.
